selection_rationale: A two-cruiser torpedo force concentrates the entire budget into a coordinated 96-round saturation strike, overwhelming even heavy point-defense walls while retaining strong armor and four PD lasers per hull.
formation_rationale: Keep both torpedo cruisers within roughly 100 km for overlapping point defense, while staggering them in x and y so the vanguard absorbs the first exchange and the reserve remains slightly harder to target with a single spinal line.
